footprints.description: Sub SMA (DO-219AB) diode, TSC drawing, 2.8 x 1.8 mm body
footprints.note: TSC Sub SMA suggested pad layout (R1; pad B 1.20 x A 1.40, C 3.10 pad-centre span = D 1.90 gap + B; E 4.30 outer), tsc/BZD27C-SERIES_AB2103.pdf p.5; body E1 2.80 mid (2.70-2.90) x D 1.80 mid (1.70-1.90). Pin 1 = cathode (band end)

footprints.description: DO-41 axial diode, onsemi drawing, 10.16 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: onsemi AXIAL LEAD CASE 59-10 (98ASB42045B), onsemi/1n5913b-d.pdf p.7, and AXIAL LEAD / DO-41 CASE 017AH (98AON13444G), onsemi/bzx85c3v3-d.pdf p.3: same maxima (R7; body A 5.20 max + 3.0 = 8.2 -> span 10.16; lead D 0.86 max + 0.25 = 1.11 -> drill 1.15, pad 1.85); body 4.65 mid (4.10-5.20) x 2.35 mid (2.00-2.70) from case 59. Pin 1 = cathode (band)

footprints.description: 3-pin SC-89 (SOT-490), onsemi drawing, 0.85 x 1.6 mm body, 0.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: onsemi SC-89 3-LEAD CASE 463C issue D (98AON11472D) recommended mounting footprint (R1; 0.53 x 0.53 pads, pins 1 and 2 at +-0.50 from the centre line, pin 3 row 1.10 from the pin 1/2 row), onsemi/BAT54CXV3-D.PDF p.4 (same drawing in onsemi/nzl5v6axv3t1-d.pdf); top view turned 90 deg CW so pins 1-2 form the left column; body E 0.85 nom x D 1.60 nom

footprints.description: SOD-323FL diode, onsemi drawing, 1.7 x 1.25 mm body
footprints.note: onsemi SOD-323FL CASE 477AB issue A recommended mounting footprint (R1; 2X 0.65 x 0.50 pads, 2.90 outer, so span 2.25), onsemi/mm3z9v1c-d.pdf p.5; body D 1.70 nom x E 1.25 nom. Pin 1 = cathode (cathode mark); the datasheet numbers the cathode 2, the two-terminal rule makes it 1
